newsitem.title: USA: ALZA, Therapeutic start drug trials.
newsitem.headline: ALZA, Therapeutic start drug trials.

text.p: ALZA Corp and Therapeutic Discovery Corp on Tuesday said patient enrollment has begun for the companies' Phase I/II clinical study for a product called Duros.

Duros, which uses ALZA's implant technology, is being developed by ALZA for Therapeutic Discovery. The product is designed to deliver leuprolide continuously for 12 months for treatment of advanced prostate cancer.
To date, more than half of about 50 patients expected to be enrolled in the multicenter study have had the Duros systems implanted.
A Duros implant, which is about the size of a matchstick, is an osmotically-driven, miniature pump that is inserted under the skin using local anesthetic.
Shares of ALZA were up 1-1/4 at 29 by mid-afternoon, while the stock of Therapeutic Discovery was off 1/8 at 10-5/8.
